summary.text: Jeff Coleman is the Libertarian candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 101, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Republican Ben Keathley and Democrat Paul Lentz.
He was unopposed in the August 4, 2026 Libertarian primary.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists earlier Libertarian candidacies for Coleman: he advanced from the Libertarian primary for Missouri State Senate District 13 in 2020, for Missouri House District 101 in 2022, and for Missouri State Senate District 15 in 2024.
